description: This file defines a CustomerGroup controller class within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing customer groups including listing, creating, editing, and deleting customer group data.

classes.name: CustomerGroup
classes.description: Controller class handling all customer group management functionalities in the Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point; loads language, constructs breadcrumb navigation, fetches list, and renders the customer group list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns output of the getList method, primarily for AJAX or partial page reloads.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches paginated list of customer groups from the model, constructs URLs, and returns the rendered list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares data for customer group creation or editing form, including loading existing data and language options, then renders the form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving or updating customer group data, validating permissions and input length, then responds with JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected customer groups after permission and usage checks, responds with success or error messages in JSON.
